meta.name: Ochre Tap Guard
meta.description: An ancient crucible catalyst from The Grand Crucible of the Tectonic Leviathan. Passed down by the smith-lords of the Under-Sun Manifold who bound magma veins and anvilstone into self-tempering thermal drills. When socketed or placed as a house amenity, this ochre construct limits the drunk drift effect of a clumsy strike and acts as a rigid guide against fat-finger taps, ensuring accidental direct taps on small screens are far less likely to destroy protected tiles, particularly in deep strata. Requires Obsidian Cinder Wick methodology.
